objective: Discriminate whether the M63 threshold-like NWell error growth is dominated by the cross-solver self-consistent response to OldSlotboom BGN by replaying the immutable 16-curve matrix with BGN explicitly disabled in both solvers and otherwise frozen settings.

closed_topics: SRH, mobility, interface, mesh, doping, contact, and bias-path selection

intervention.single_conceptual_axis: OldSlotboom BGN on versus explicit no-BGN in both solvers
intervention.sentaurus_math: Math { Extrapolate RelErrControl Digits=8 ErrRef(Electron)=1e2 ErrRef(Hole)=1e2 Iterations=20 ExitOnFailure CNormPrint }
intervention.reference_policy: M64 is a causal diagnostic intervention and does not replace M8, M46, or M60 references

analysis.point_error_dex: log10(abs(Vela drain current) / abs(Sentaurus drain current))
analysis.bgn_mismatch_component_dex: BGN-on point error minus BGN-off point error
analysis.nwell_growth_dex: high-NWell point error minus paired low-NWell point error at the frozen M63 diagnostic gate
analysis.bgn_explained_nwell_growth_dex: BGN-on NWell growth minus BGN-off NWell growth
analysis.pair_closure_fraction: one minus abs(BGN-off NWell growth) divided by abs(BGN-on NWell growth), clipped to [0,1] only for classification
analysis.horizontal_shift_crosscheck: fit the same local-slope least-squares horizontal-shift model independently to BGN-on and BGN-off smooth-window curves
analysis.claim_guard: A dominant result attributes the paired smooth growth to the cross-solver self-consistent response to BGN; it does not identify an error in the shared OldSlotboom delta-Eg formula, authorize parameter fitting, or change production defaults.

forbidden_work: changing Digits, ErrRef, RelErrControl, Iterations, or CNormPrint
changing HFS, SG, SRH, mobility, interface, contact, mesh, doping, statistics, or bias path
using DirectCurrent or revisiting generic contact extraction
tuning either solver after observing the no-BGN result
replacing M8, M46, or M60 reference data
claiming that BGN formula parity is broken without an independent formula-level contradiction
